case: D120 native extension reload event ordering

measurement.receipt: The guest Scrape run persists the sanitized lifecycle evidence on both successful reload and reload failure.
records: discovery enablement, initial snapshot, listener registration, pre-click snapshot, click start and resolution
owned target created, changed and destroyed events with target ID, type and wall-clock time
changed poll snapshots, final snapshot and unchanged acceptance predicate
measurement.bounds: At most 80 timeline entries; snapshots and capture output contain at most 16 owned targets each. No target URL, title or page content is emitted.
measurement.interpretation: A missing old-worker destroyed event remains unverified. Pre-click disappearance is reported separately from post-click event absence.
